description: Revoke an identity, making it unable to spend funds or sign transactions. Only the revocation authority (or token revocation authority) can perform this action. A revoked identity can only be restored by the recovery authority using recoveridentity. This is a safety mechanism — use it if the identity's private keys are compromised.

identity.description: VerusID name (e.g., "alice@") or i-address to revoke

returntx.description: If true, return signed transaction hex instead of broadcasting. Default: false.

sourceoffunds.description: Source address for funds. If the user has not specified a preferred address, ask which address to use or if they prefer a wildcard ("*", "R*", "i*", or "z*" for private txs).

tokenrevoke.description: If true, use the tokenized ID control token to revoke. Default: false.

name: revokeidentity
